settings.providers.keyStoredFoot: Key stored in a private file on this Mac, readable only by you. Not in the macOS Keychain, and not shared with OMP.

settings.providers.ompFoot: Connected through your OMP setup. OpenVids only reads it and can’t change or remove it from here.

settings.signin.waiting.device: Waiting for you to enter the code in the browser…
settings.signin.waiting.browser: Waiting for you to finish in the browser…

settings.jev.credential.keyHint: Keeps Jev’s usage and rate limits apart
settings.jev.key.savedHint: Saved in a private file on this Mac
settings.jev.test.hint: Sends a short prompt with the settings above.
settings.jev.lede: A fast worker the Director and specialists hand small, well-defined tasks. It doesn’t take part in chats on its own.

settings.assets.mode.trusted.hint: Search only the sources below. Each one notes its license terms.
settings.assets.mode.any.hint: Search the web. Check each asset’s license before you publish.
settings.assets.lede: Applies to all projects. Only the Research agent searches outside a project, and only as allowed here.
settings.assets.meta.trusted: {on} of {total} on · Only these are searched
settings.assets.meta.any: {on} of {total} on · Searched first, then the rest of the web
settings.assets.empty: No trusted sources. Add a site below.
settings.assets.empty.restore: No trusted sources. Add a site below, or restore the built-in sources.
settings.assets.allOff: All sources are off, so asset search will find nothing.
settings.assets.readLinked: Open links you send in chat
settings.assets.readLinked.hint: Agents can read the pages you link — colors, fonts, logo, screenshots — to match a site’s style. Only links from your own messages, plus other pages on the same site.
settings.execution.quality.fast.note: Quickest. One render check, no correction round.
settings.execution.quality.balanced.note: The default for most edits. Checks the render and corrects once.
settings.execution.quality.best.note: Slowest and most thorough. Three QA passes, deeper research.
settings.execution.quality.custom.note: Your own budget, field by field.
settings.execution.thinking.configured.h: Specialists think as you configured them.
settings.execution.field.qaFramesPerMinu: How densely Vision samples the rendered video. {min}–{max}.
How densely Vision samples the rendered video. {min}–{max}. Unused while render QA is off.
settings.execution.field.qaMaxFrames.hin: The most frames Vision looks at in one pass. {min}–{max}.
The most frames Vision looks at in one pass. {min}–{max}. Unused while render QA is off.
settings.execution.field.analysisFramesP: Frames Vision inspects per source file when analysing long footage. {min}–{max}.
settings.execution.critique.hint: How often Vision may ask for a closer look in one pass. {min}–{max}.
settings.execution.critique.hintUnused: How often Vision may ask for a closer look in one pass. {min}–{max}. Unused while render QA is off.
settings.execution.passes.off: Render QA is off: the agent does not render and check its work.
settings.execution.passes.one: One render, checked and reported; no automatic correction.
settings.execution.passes.many: Up to {passes, plural, one {# render} other {# renders}}, each checked; at most {corrections, plural, one {# correction} other {# corrections}} in between.
settings.execution.summary.critique: Critique {count, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}}
settings.execution.summary.research: Research {count, plural, one {# candidate} other {# candidates}}
settings.execution.foot: How hard agents work in chats that have no choice of their own. A chat’s Execution quality control overrides this.
settings.execution.askLocked: Ask before changing locked or hand-edited sections
settings.execution.askLocked.hintOn: Agents stop and ask before touching them.
settings.execution.askLocked.hintOff: Agents leave them as they are, carry on and report what they skipped. Locked material is never changed either way.
settings.execution.askDownloads.hintOn: Agents list what they found and wait for your approval.
settings.execution.askDownloads.hintOff: Agents download what fits without asking.

onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to OpenVids
onboarding.welcome.lede: A video editor you work in together with AI agents, by chat. Describe what you want; the agents cut, time and review it with you on the timeline.
onboarding.welcome.chat.title: You and the agents, in one chat
onboarding.welcome.chat.text: Ask for an edit or a whole video. The Director plans it and its specialists do the cutting, titles and audio. You can step in by hand at any point.
onboarding.welcome.local.title: Everything runs on this Mac
onboarding.welcome.local.text: The editor, rendering and your files stay local. AI requests go only to the provider you connect.
onboarding.welcome.folder.title: A project is a folder
onboarding.welcome.folder.text: Plain files in a folder you choose: open them in Finder, copy them, back them up.
onboarding.models.title: Connect a model
onboarding.models.lede: The agents need a model from an AI provider. Sign in to one, or add an API key.
onboarding.models.foot: Your key or sign-in is stored on this Mac. The frames and transcripts the agents look at are sent to the provider you choose.
onboarding.models.skipLoading: You can skip this step: the editor works by hand without a model.
onboarding.models.connected.hint: The agents can use {count, plural, one {its models} other {their models}}.
onboarding.models.skip: You can skip this step: the editor works by hand without a model, and you can connect one later in Settings.

onboarding.system.orRunItNoBrew: Or run it in Terminal, then press Check again. Homebrew isn’t installed: <action>Get Homebrew</action>.
onboarding.system.installYourself: Install {tool} yourself, then press Check again.

onboarding.system.lede: OpenVids needs Chrome and FFmpeg to render your video and make thumbnails.
onboarding.system.speech: Speech recognition downloads its model the first time you use it.
onboarding.system.continueAnyway: You can continue; OpenVids will tell you when something it needs is missing.
onboarding.project.title: Your first project
onboarding.project.lede: Every project is a folder of plain files. New ones are created in the folder below.
onboarding.project.location.hint: Change it any time in Settings → General.

onboarding.project.foot: Finish opens Projects with the start box ready. You can reopen this from Help → Welcome to OpenVids.
